tools.name: narrated_video_plan
tools.title: Plan a narrated-video job
tools.description: Run `python -m narrate video plan --json` on one job in the narrated-video store: the admit gate (narrate job and script digest, consent and revocation, persona label, bed record and its acquisition by the operator, tighten on synthetic narration, knob bounds, the kitpip pin, Edition.check at Plan), then one stage key, state and reason per node of the 13-stage graph (fresh, stale, corrupt, blocked, refused, not_selected or pending_operator), the nodes ready to run and the operator gates still open. Reads the job, the record renders, the private kitpip pin and, when named, the private store's digests; writes nothing unless record is true, and then only graph.json. Runs no stage, starts no engine and never spawns kitpip. Results carry ids, keys and digests, never a store path or a clip. Speech workflow, not a guitar default: the guitar axioms in AGENTS.md do not apply; every narrated-video stage manifest that carries narration, an overlay or a bed says no_time_stretch false with a non-identity mapping (narrated_video_v1, avatar_overlay_v1 or music_bed_v1), so no guitar tool accepts it (docs/spec/TIMELINE_CONTRACT.md).

tools.name: vrm_overlay
tools.title: Render a VRM overlay (draft)
tools.description: Run the avatar stage of one job whose avatar.external is vrm (`python -m narrate video stage JOB avatar --segment ID --json`): check the model's likeness consent (SP-R13), appearance approval (TIN-7130), open badge decision and Internal edition, resolve VRM_RENDERER_BIN against the private pin, build face.json (face.timeline/v1) from the segment's narrate run at the base's frame rate, run the renderer (three-vrm in headless Chromium stepping vrm.update(1/fps) per frame) on the model from the private store, stream its raw RGBA frames into a ProRes 4444 overlay and write an avatar.manifest/v1 with the model digest, the VRM meta licence fields, the renderer, the GPU and driver and frames_identity per_host. Everything lands in the stage's partial directory in the job store, never inside the narrate run or under artifacts/runs/. Refuses vrm_model_missing, vrm_model_invalid, vrm_digest_mismatch, vrm_consent_missing, vrm_consent_revoked, vrm_approval_missing, vrm_badge_undecided, vrm_edition_unruled, vrm_pin_pending, vrm_pin_mismatch, vrm_renderer_missing, vrm_invalid, vrm_meta_missing, vrm_frames_mismatch, vrm_report_invalid, face_timeline_invalid and avatar_outside_store, and relays the renderer's own codes. Never passes --badge or --realtime. Speech workflow, not a guitar default: the guitar axioms in AGENTS.md do not apply; the overlay manifest says no_time_stretch false with the non-identity mapping avatar_overlay_v1, so no guitar tool accepts it (docs/spec/TIMELINE_CONTRACT.md).

limitations: Draft (SPR-128). The demos keep kitpip (SPR-120); the switch waits for the 11-14 go/hold bench. Only the Internal edition may carry a VRM overlay until a ruling.

GPU raster is not bit-exact: frames_sha256 holds per host only (frames_identity per_host). Compare digests only between renders on one host, renderer and driver.
face.json follows narration loudness only (source loudness_envelope); word and phoneme timings are a later source. Lip sync stays pending_operator.
Whether offline VRM video carries a burned-in badge is open: no renderer draws one, and a model record that tries to settle it refuses vrm_badge_undecided.

tools.name: narrated_video_mix
tools.title: Mix voice and bed
tools.description: Run the mix stage of one job (`python -m narrate video stage JOB mix --json`): re-measure the placed voice (it must sit within driftLu of targetLufs; nothing loudness-normalises it), set the bed bedBelowVoiceLu under the measured voice, duck it duckDb under the foreground (Sidechain on voice plus kept clip sound, or EdlEnvelope on the placed spans) with attackMs and releaseMs ramps, fade it fadeInS in and fadeOutS out, sum, and run one limiter 0.5 dB under truePeakDbtp. Measures the mix: drift over driftLu refuses loudness_drift and a true peak above truePeakDbtp refuses true_peak_exceeded. Writes mix.wav, bed-ducked.wav and mix.json with the measured loudness, true peak, bed gain and applied duck depth. Speech workflow, not a guitar default: the guitar axioms in AGENTS.md do not apply; every stage manifest that carries narration or a bed says no_time_stretch false with a non-identity mapping (narration_v1, narrated_video_v1 or music_bed_v1), so no guitar tool accepts it (docs/spec/TIMELINE_CONTRACT.md).
tools.intent: Let an agent compare bed level and duck settings at matched voice loudness, with the delivery gates checked on every mix.

job.description: The job id: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit. The job lives in the store root as <root>/<job>/job.json (write it with `just nv-init`).

Lanes L4 to L6 run every stage: script, voice, voice_qa, base, place, music, mix, compose, deliver_check and handoff, and avatar and avatar_check when the job has an avatar and its kitpip pin resolves. compose waits behind the avatar stages.
The applied duck depth is the envelope the stage applied, a measurement, not a listening result.
Stereo writes the mono mix on both channels at -3.01 dB each; mono is the default until an A/B (NV-2).

agent_workflow.identify: Read integrated_lufs, drift_lu, true_peak_dbtp, voice_integrated_lufs, bed_gain_db, duck_depth_db and flags.
agent_workflow.research: docs/spec/NARRATED_VIDEO.md "Simple path (lane L4)", Mix levels; the deck project's ruling 58 set 20 LU under the voice.
agent_workflow.iterate: Change duckDb (6 to 8) or duckMode alone, rerun mix only, and compare two mix.json files at the same voice loudness.
agent_workflow.acceptance: A fresh stage is evidence that it ran on these inputs. Listening, Content ID and delivery are separate operator states.

tools.name: narrated_video_compose
tools.title: Compose a narrated video
tools.description: Run the compose stage of one job (`python -m narrate video stage JOB compose --json`) and, with handoff true, the handoff stage: scale the base to the delivery profile (Web1080p30, Talk or Contingency), lay on the slide pages (layout Full or CardLowerLeft: a lower-left card over the held next-clip frame dimmed to dimTo, fades and in-place crossfades over fadeS) and each segment's kitpip overlay (ProRes 4444, straight alpha) at its corner from the segment start, hidden with fades over every page avatarOff lists, then encode video.mp4 (H.264 yuv420p, AAC 48 kHz, soft captions) and video.upload.mp4. Writes captions.srt and captions.vtt from the narrate runs' cues on the base clock, description.txt from a fixed template, chapters.json and compose.json. Handoff writes layers/ (bare base, overlays, slide pictures, stems, captions) and edit.json with every input's stage key. Refuses captions_burn_unsupported, captions_missing, slides_exceed_program, overlay_exceeds_base, frames_mismatch and label_chain_broken. Speech workflow, not a guitar default: the guitar axioms in AGENTS.md do not apply; every stage manifest that carries narration, an overlay or a bed says no_time_stretch false with a non-identity mapping (narration_v1, narrated_video_v1, avatar_overlay_v1 or music_bed_v1), so no guitar tool accepts it (docs/spec/TIMELINE_CONTRACT.md).
tools.intent: Let an agent compose a labelled narrated cut at a delivery profile, compare slide and overlay layouts, and hand pre-VFX layers to an editor.

tools.name: narrated_video_verify
tools.title: Check delivery gates
tools.description: Run the deliver_check stage of one job (`python -m narrate video stage JOB deliver_check --json`): probe video.mp4 against its profile (codec, pixel format, size, rate, channels, frames, caption track), measure the delivered loudness and true peak, measure the flash gate at every slide change (the largest adjacent-frame mean-luma jump, at most 30%), check the captions, persona cue and description notice, and report the operator gates (listening, lip sync, and with upload and a bed the licence PDF digest and Content ID) as pending_operator. Writes deliver_check.json with per-gate states and delivery_gate (internal_review_allowed, upload_gates_closed, public_upload_allowed; the last stays false while any operator state is pending, so deliver_check never reports it true).
